# Change the appearance of the folder tree

<!-- generated by docs:update_by_ai -->
<!-- page type: how-to -->

Adjust the indentation, row height, and indent guides in the Files sidebar section.

## Choose the folder tree appearance
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/glossary.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/FilesPanel.vue -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/SourceControlMenu.vue -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/i18n/locales/en/filesPanel.json -->

1. Select **More options**, the three vertical dots in the header of the Files sidebar section.
2. Choose an option for the setting you want to change from the table below.

| Setting | What changes | Choices |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Indentation** | The space before files and folders at each folder level. | **Small**, **Medium**, **Large** |
| **Row height** | The height of each row. | **Compact**, **Comfortable** |
| **Indent guides** | The lines that show folder levels. | **Show**, **Hide** |

The folder tree updates and the menu closes after each choice. If you want to change another setting, repeat steps 1 and 2.

## Related pages

- [Browse files and folders](/documentation/browse_files): to find files in the folder tree.
- [Files sidebar section](/documentation/files_sidebar_reference): to look up the available choices.
- [Create a file or folder](/documentation/create_a_file_or_folder): to add an item to the tree.

# Browse files and folders

<!-- generated by docs:update_by_ai -->
<!-- page type: how-to -->

Find files and folders in the selected workspace and choose which folders are open in the Files sidebar section.

## Browse the folder tree
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/glossary.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/FilesPanel.vue -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/stores/files.ts -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/i18n/locales/en/filesPanel.json -->

1. Select the **Files** icon in the left sidebar icon bar to open the Files sidebar section for the selected workspace.
2. Find a file or folder in the tree; folders appear before files, and each group is in alphabetical order.
3. Click a folder to fold or unfold it, or click a file to select its row and open it in the large Git window.

Folders ignored by Git appear only when the option to show ignored files is enabled. An ignored folder cannot be unfolded.

Select **Refresh** to read the folder tree again, or select **Collapse all folders** to fold every folder.

### The Files sidebar section says the workspace is not a Git repository
**Cause**: The selected workspace is not a Git repository.
**Solution**:
1. Select a workspace that is a Git repository.
2. Open the **Files** sidebar section.
**Check**: The folder tree appears.

# Files sidebar section

<!-- generated by docs:update_by_ai -->
<!-- page type: reference -->

Look up what the Files sidebar section shows and what its controls do.

## Folder tree contents and rows
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/glossary.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/FilesPanel.vue -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/stores/files.ts -->

The folder tree lists files tracked by Git, new files, and empty folders created in Heidrun during the current session. Folders appear before files, and each group is sorted alphabetically. Empty folders disappear from the tree after Heidrun restarts because Git does not list empty folders.

Folders ignored by Git appear only when the option to show ignored files is enabled; an ignored folder cannot be unfolded. The rows show, from left to right, indentation guides or spacing, a folder arrow when available, an icon, and the name. Changed files show a colored status letter at the right of the row, and a folder containing changed files shows a dot; file and folder icons are grey.

## Header buttons
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/glossary.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/FilesPanel.vue -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/i18n/locales/en/filesPanel.json -->

| Button | Action |
| --- | --- |
| **New file** | Starts creating an empty file in the selected folder, the folder of the selected file, or the repository root. |
| **New folder** | Starts creating an empty folder in the selected folder, the folder of the selected file, or the repository root. |
| **Refresh** | Reads the folder tree again. |
| **Collapse all folders** | Folds every folder. |
| **More options** | Opens the choices for indentation, row height, and indent guides. |

## More options
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/FilesPanel.vue -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/i18n/locales/en/filesPanel.json -->

| Choice | Options |
| --- | --- |
| **Indentation** | **Small**, **Medium**, or **Large** |
| **Row height** | **Compact** or **Comfortable** |
| **Indent guides** | **Show** or **Hide** |

A check mark in the menu shows the active choice.

## Selection and open folders
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/glossary.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/FilesPanel.vue -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/stores/files.ts -->

Only one row can be selected at a time. Each workspace remembers its selected row, and Heidrun unfolds the folders above that row when the workspace is selected again. The selection remains when you switch to another sidebar section or close the large Git window; clicking empty space in the Files sidebar section clears the selection for the selected workspace.

Folder open and folded states remain when you switch sidebar sections. When you change to a workspace with a different repository, the folder tree resets and the folders above that workspace's selected row unfold.

## File context menu
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/glossary.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/FilesPanel.vue -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/i18n/locales/en/filesPanel.json -->

Right-click a file row to open its context menu. The menu has these choices:

| Choice | Action |
| --- | --- |
| **Copy absolute path** | Copies the file's full path. |
| **Copy relative path** | Copies the file's path relative to the selected workspace. |

After a copy, Heidrun shows the copied path in a message. Folder rows do not have a context menu.

# Create a file or folder

<!-- generated by docs:update_by_ai -->
<!-- page type: how-to -->

Create an empty file or folder in the repository of the selected workspace.

## Choose where to create the item
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/glossary.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/FilesPanel.vue -->

Select a folder to create the item there, or select a file to create the item in that file's folder. With no row selected, the item goes in the repository root.

## Create the file or folder
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/glossary.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/FilesPanel.vue -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/desktop_tauri/src/files.rs -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/i18n/locales/en/filesPanel.json -->

1. Select **New file** or **New folder** in the Files sidebar section.
2. Type a name without `/` in the name box inside the folder tree.
3. Press **Enter** to create the item.

The new row is selected. A new file also opens in the large Git window. Press **Escape** or click outside the name box to cancel.

## Troubleshooting
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/glossary.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/FilesPanel.vue -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/desktop_tauri/src/files.rs -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/i18n/locales/en/filesPanel.json -->

### The name box stays open after Enter
**Cause**: The name contains `/` or a file or folder with that name already exists in the destination folder.
**Solution**:
1. Remove `/` from the name, or choose a name that is not already in the destination folder.
2. Press **Enter** again.
**Check**: The new row appears in the folder tree and is selected.
